answer: A new agent cannot enter the harbor of trusted peers until a sponsor risks its own reputation on it, and that sponsor is scored on every newcomer it vouches for. A sybil farmer must therefore chain real, slashable reputation through each fake identity. Once an opal-grade vouch fails, the whole lineage is cut and its rewards vanish at dawn. The cost of one identity becomes the cost of a credible backer, so mass registration starves.
